Three files co-occur; `kstack-jira.mjs` is the code under test, and the other two are triaged with specific, checkable claims — `kstack-provider-runner.mjs`'s only Jira mention is the `JIRA|ATLASSIAN_(API_TOKEN|EMAIL)` redaction regex, and `kstack-config.mjs`'s are confined to `validateJiraConfig()` shape validation of `.kstack/config.json`. The `grep -rln \"exit code\\|exit-code\\|EXIT\\.\"` over `plugins/kstack/skills/*/SKILL.md` returning zero matches is the right evidence for \"no SKILL.md can be stale\" — omission is the correct non-stale state.\n- Test coverage exercises exit 20 on all three consumers of `gateExitCode` (unfreeze, submit-dry-run, discard) and pins the boundary at `now - 29999` (below floor → 20) against unparseable/future (→ 2), plus the collision-free exit inventory assertion including 20.\n\nOne maintainability nit, non-blocking and not worth another round: `preMutationDuplicateGate` returns `reason: VERIFICATION_REASON.INDEX_LAG` on the young-marker branch while writing `MARKER_YOUNGER_THAN_INDEX_LAG_MINIMUM` into the audit on the same branch, and `gateExitCode` keys off `INDEX_LAG` — a value that appears nowhere else. A future \"normalize these two strings\" edit would silently revert exit 20 to exit 2.
